# ATCSCC Advisories Database

- Publisher: FAA Air Traffic Control System Command Center
- URL: https://www.fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_list (a UTC day's list), /adv/adv_otherdis (each advisory)
- Licence: Public domain: a work of the U.S. Government, not subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. § 105).
- Use in b6-v1: Every advisory whose control element is the hub (ground delay programs, ground stops, their revisions and cancellations, arrival delay notices), as raw text at its signature time: news kind 'advisory', speaker 'FAA Command Center'. Pinned per UTC day and hub by the sha256 of the parsed records (advisory number, header, message, signature, effective time) as sorted-key compact JSON.
